name: NBKB B2B Wholesale for WooCommerce – Wholesale Prices, Role Based Pricing & Registration
author: nbkblabs

sections.description:
NBKB B2B Wholesale for WooCommerce lets you run a hybrid B2B store and retail storefront from the same WooCommerce catalog without duplicating products or slowing down checkout.

Configure role-based wholesale pricing for simple and variable products, create unlimited wholesale user roles with storewide percentage discounts, enforce minimum order quantity (MOQ) rules, apply automatic tax and VAT exemption, bulk update prices via WooCommerce CSV import and export, block retail coupons for wholesale buyers, and onboard trade accounts with a dedicated B2B registration form.

Why Choose NBKB B2B Wholesale

Manage wholesale pricing, custom customer groups, and order quantity rules in WooCommerce without heavy scripts or complicated setup.

  • Custom Customer Tiers: Create unlimited wholesale user roles (VIP, Distributor, Trade Partner) with independent labels and global percentage discounts.
  • Lightweight & HPOS Native: Built on standard WooCommerce data structures with full High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart/Checkout Blocks support.
  • Single-Catalog Hybrid Store: Serve retail shoppers and wholesale buyers from one shared inventory.
  • Hidden From Retail Buyers: Wholesale rates stay hidden from guests and standard shoppers until an approved wholesale account signs in.

Key Features

  • Unlimited Custom Wholesale Roles: Create, edit, and delete custom wholesale roles (such as VIP, Distributor, or Trade Partner) with standard WordPress role capabilities.
  • Global Storewide Role Discounts: Set catalog-wide percentage discounts for specific wholesale roles from a single settings page.
  • Category-Wise Wholesale Discounts: Assign percentage wholesale discounts per product category, taking precedence over storewide role discounts when no product-level price is set.
  • Hide Prices & Add to Cart for Guests: Enable Private Store / Catalog Mode to hide product prices and block guest purchasing with a customizable login CTA button.
  • In-Account Wholesale Upgrade: Logged-in retail customers can request a wholesale account upgrade directly from the Wholesale Upgrade tab inside WooCommerce My Account.
  • Custom Login Redirect for Wholesale: Automatically redirect verified wholesale buyers to your wholesale catalog or custom landing page after login.
  • Simple Product Wholesale Pricing: Set dedicated wholesale prices and minimum order quantities (MOQ) on simple products.
  • Variable Product Wholesale Pricing: Set independent wholesale prices and minimum order quantities for each product variation (size, color, etc.).
  • Automatic Tax & VAT Exemption: Automatically exempt verified wholesale customers from sales tax and VAT at checkout with a simple 1-click admin toggle.
  • Native WooCommerce CSV Bulk Import & Export: Bulk import and export wholesale prices and minimum quantities directly through standard WooCommerce CSV product tools.
  • Disable Retail Coupons for Wholesale: Prevent wholesale buyers from stacking retail marketing coupons on top of already discounted wholesale rates.
  • Custom Wholesale Price Label: Brand your wholesale price badge (e.g. “Trade Price”, “VIP Price”, “Wholesale”) and optionally hide crossed-out regular retail prices.
  • Guest Wholesale Notice: Display a subtle notice on product pages prompting retail visitors to log in or apply for a wholesale account.
  • Dedicated Wholesale Registration Form: Register commercial buyers easily using the clean [nbkb_b2b_registration] shortcode.
  • Order Details & Savings: View wholesale savings, customer role snapshots, and item pricing directly in WooCommerce order details.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS): Native compatibility with WooCommerce custom order tables (custom_order_tables).
  • WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks: Full compatibility with modern block checkout and classic shortcode checkout.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nbkb-b2b-wholesale folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via your WordPress Admin Plugins screen (Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to B2B Wholesale (or WooCommerce > B2B Wholesale) to configure your settings.
  4. Edit any Simple or Variable product in Products > All Products to set your wholesale prices.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support variable products?

Yes. You can configure independent wholesale prices and minimum order quantities for each product variation (size, color, etc.) directly in the product variation settings.

Can I hide prices and Add to Cart buttons from guest visitors?

Yes. Under B2B Wholesale > Settings, enable Hide Prices for Guests and Hide Add to Cart for Guests. Unauthenticated visitors see your custom login button instead of prices or purchase buttons.

Can I set wholesale discounts by product category?

Yes. Edit any WooCommerce product category under Products > Categories and enter a Wholesale Discount (%). Category discounts apply automatically when a product does not have an individual fixed wholesale price, taking priority over storewide role discounts.

How do customers become wholesale buyers?

Customers can register directly using the [nbkb_b2b_registration] shortcode on any page, existing logged-in retail shoppers can apply from the Wholesale Upgrade tab inside WooCommerce My Account, or administrators can manually assign a wholesale role under Users > All Users.

Can I import wholesale prices using WooCommerce CSV Import?

Yes. NBKB B2B Wholesale integrates directly with WooCommerce’s native Product CSV Importer and Exporter. You will see dedicated “Wholesale Price” and “Wholesale Min Quantity” columns in your CSV files.

Does this plugin prevent wholesale customers from using retail coupons?

Yes. Enable the “Disable Retail Coupons” toggle in B2B Wholesale > Settings. Wholesale buyers will be prevented from applying retail coupons at checkout.

Can I change the “Wholesale Price” text to “Trade Price” or “VIP Rate”?

Yes. You can set any custom label under B2B Wholesale > Settings. You can also choose to hide the original retail crossed-out price so wholesale customers only see the wholesale rate.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, NBKB B2B Wholesale is built with native compatibility for High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS / Custom Order Tables) and WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Feature: Private Store / Catalog Mode – Hide product prices and Add to Cart buttons from guest visitors with customizable login CTA text and destination URL.
  • Feature: Category-Wise Wholesale Discounts – Set percentage wholesale discounts per product category (Products > Categories) with automatic priority over storewide role discounts.
  • Feature: In-Account Wholesale Upgrade Request – Added a Wholesale Upgrade tab inside WooCommerce My Account so existing logged-in shoppers can apply for a wholesale account without duplicating accounts.
  • Feature: Wholesale Login Redirect – Redirect verified wholesale accounts to a dedicated wholesale catalog or store page immediately after login.
  • Enhancement: Aligned plugin header title with readme.txt and updated compatibility to WordPress 7.2 and WooCommerce 11.3.
  • Performance: Added per-request caching for category discounts and optimized role lookups to avoid redundant database queries.

1.2.1.3

  • Enhancement: Updated in-app upgrade links to direct to the dedicated B2B Wholesale product page.
  • Tweak: Refreshed plugin visual assets with centered, evergreen repository display banners.

1.2.1.2

  • Enhancement: Added helpful storefront preview note for store administrators in the product pricing metabox.
  • Fix: Synchronized catalog and cart pricing by basing role discounts on regular price to prevent double-discounting on retail sale prices.
  • Optimization: Compacted directory short description to under 150 characters for clean display in WordPress search cards.

1.2.1.1

  • Tweak: Streamlined “Upgrade to Pro” admin submenu with highlighted background styling and clean title (removed redundant PRO tag).
  • Tweak: Polished post-activation welcome notice to use clean native WordPress notice markup with a direct settings link.
  • Fix: Extended review request notice delay to a strict 14 days to ensure new store owners are never interrupted early.
  • Tweak: Updated B2B Wholesale admin menu icon with a crisp, brand-matched monochrome vector monogram.

1.2.1

  • Feature: Dedicated Top-Level Admin Menu – Added prominent “B2B Wholesale” main sidebar menu with custom NBKB brand icon for easy access.
  • Feature: Dynamic Sidebar Submenus – Directly navigate to Settings, Wholesale Roles, and Pro modules from the WordPress sidebar.
  • Feature: Post-Activation Onboarding Banner – Welcome notice with quick links to the B2B dashboard and wholesale roles manager.
  • Enhancement: Retained backward-compatible menu access under WooCommerce > B2B Wholesale.

1.2.0

  • Feature: Custom Wholesale Roles Manager – Create, edit, and delete unlimited custom wholesale customer roles (such as VIP, Distributor, or Trade Partner) from B2B Wholesale > Wholesale Roles.
  • Feature: Global Storewide Role Discounts – Configure dedicated storewide percentage discounts across all catalog items for specific wholesale customer groups.
  • Enhancement: Safe role deletion with automatic user reassignment to default wholesale customer role to ensure zero orphaned customer accounts.
  • Performance: Optimized wholesale role runtime caching and filter bridges.

1.1.0

  • Feature: Added coupon restriction option to disable retail coupons for wholesale buyers at checkout to prevent double discounting.
  • Feature: Added custom Wholesale Price Label setting to personalize price badges (e.g. “Trade Price”, “VIP Price”, “Wholesale”).
  • Feature: Added toggle to hide crossed-out regular retail prices from wholesale customers.
  • Feature: Added native WooCommerce CSV Product Import & Export integration for bulk wholesale pricing and minimum quantities.
  • Feature: Added guest and retail wholesale availability notice on product pages with direct login and registration links.

1.0.1

  • Fix: Resolved variation Wholesale Price label styling and alignment in admin product editor.
  • Fix: Automatically update frontend quantity input to the variation’s minimum wholesale order quantity upon variation selection.
  • Fix: Enforced variation-level minimum order quantity during cart validation and add-to-cart process.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added role-based pricing for Simple and Variable products.
  • Added automatic tax/VAT exemption for wholesale roles.
  • Added [nbkb_b2b_registration] frontend registration shortcode.
  • Added permanent B2B order metadata and line item savings tracking.
  • Added full HPOS (Custom Order Tables) and Cart/Checkout Blocks compatibility.
